description.text: This model is a fine-tuned version of the unsloth/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B model, specifically adapted for medical reasoning tasks. The fine-tuning process utilized the FreedomIntelligence/medical-o1-reasoning-SFT dataset, which focuses on complex chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in the medical domain. The model has been optimized using the unsloth and trl libraries, with LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) techniques applied to enhance performance while maintaining efficiency.

output_type.quote: It can be used to generate responses to medical questions, provide explanations, and assist in medical decision-making processes.

serving.notes: The chat template leaves system_prompt empty unless the caller passes a system message. It uses DeepSeek-style User/Assistant markers and strips text before </think>. The repo has four pytorch_model.bin shards and no adapter_config.json. The card does not say whether the LoRA was merged. Training regime is stated as mixed precision (fp16/bf16); the card does not say the base was quantized. config.json torch_dtype is float16. The Kaggle link returned a page shell without the notebook source. arXiv HTML for 2604.17988 returned 404. The dataset viewer total is 90,120 rows across en (19,704), en_mix (24,887), zh (20,171), and zh_mix (25,358); the card does not say which config was used.
